notes: Class of 2025 remains the most recent class profile published on the school's site (no 2026 or 2027 profile found). Tuition: Northeastern bills the full-time MBA per credit hour, 1931 per credit for 2026-27 (1884 for 2025-26) under the D'Amore-McKim graduate programs rate, plus a 3100 program fee billed in year one, per https://studentfinance.northeastern.edu/billing-payments/tuition-and-fees/ (fetched this session); no annual tuition figure is published, so tuition_usd left null rather than computed. Salary: the Fall 2024 employment stats sheet publishes an average salary of 97840 and average signing bonus of 10000; no median published, so salary_median_usd left null. Work experience and GRE splits are not published.
